page.layout: One page of text, single column; a large drop-cap initial E at the start of the first paragraph; page number at top left; running head absent; the heading APPENDIX centred above the text.; One block of text: a heading at the top centre, then a two-column list of Hebrew month names with their Latin equivalents, and a catchword-like word at the foot right. A library stamp at the right margin is not transcribed.

main_text.head: APPENDIX.
main_text.p: E Tiamsi eorum gratia, qui linguis orientalibus non adeo sunt exercitati ab exoticis quibuscunque characteribus, per totas hasce Institutiones Chronologicas prudens abstinui; nè tamen iis qui linguas etiam doctas chronologicis suis addiderunt studiis, hic desideraretur; menses saltem orientales, aliáque nonnulla ad eos pertinentia, propriis suis characteribus exarata appendere, non operae pretium tantùm, sed & necessarium duxi. Menses igitur suos orientis incolae hunc in modum exprimunt.
main_text.head: Menses Hebraici. v. l. i. c. 14.

page.notes: Hebrew month names are set in Hebrew letters as printed; the Hebrew column is right-aligned against the Latin names. Some Hebrew letters in the first column are worn and read with uncertainty, notably the forms in lines 2 to 4 and 7 to 8. Stamp and watermark text (Google, library stamp) omitted.
